claims.title: Budget interface work, inherited repair seams and fast sacrificial-network recovery separately

quoted_fields.interface: Declared load path, useful path density/force/work, deformation geometry and actual material inventory; for reliability, an exact series stack or explicitly resetting architecture and independent fixed hazards. Recovery uses constant disabled fraction p and one first-order inactive-site recovery law. None is inferred from click conversion, chemical-site renewal or initial tensile recovery.
quoted_fields.failure: These are conditional models, not universal material laws. Stored elastic energy sigma^2*h/(2E) is geometry-specific, not a measured crack energy-release rate. Path densities computed from required traction are minimally sufficient in the toy equal-load model, not a general cap on actual path count or toughness. Ideal alignment/constant sliding/complete utilization need physical support. Deep reconnection must actually unload old seams; correlated/common failures and aging alter product reliability. A recovered active fraction is not a fatigue-threshold or joint-survival certificate. N1017 initial graft/window results remain unchanged; this return does not recover missing predecessor renewal/helper code. Continuous reinforcement allocation/numerical optima and cited component materials are source reports, not a measured molecular optimum or integrated living reconstruction.
